description: (Pomona, California) – Michelle Rodriguez, a member of the Commission on Peace Officers Standards and Training (POST), announced today that she raised $114,000 in the twenty-two days before the new year for her campaign to succeed her husband, Assemblymember Freddie Rodriguez in the newly-drawn 53rd District. The election is on March 5, 2024. View press
paid_for_by: Paid for by Michelle Rodriguez for Assembly 2026 • FPPC ID 1477034 • 2063 Rancho Valley Dr
title: Commissioner Michelle Rodriguez – who raised more than $114,000in December – announces her candidacy for 53rd State Assembly seat - Michelle for Assembly
